metadata.notes: Arkansas has 4 libraries with Library of Things programs. CALS Tool Library at Dee Brown Library allows up to 5 tools (max 3 power tools). Bentonville has 182+ items across technology, crafts, music, and wellness. Malvern lends gadgets, tools, games, kits, and electronics (1-week loan). Southeast AR lends outdoor games, fishing gear, tech, and educational kits.
